title: 電網廣域相量量測
summary: 以時間同步、相量誤差與廣域資料品質串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect time synchronization, phasor error and wide-area data quality through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 相量與時間
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「相量與時間」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop phasors and time through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 相量定義：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「相量定義」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for phasor definition.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「相量定義」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。相量把近似正弦訊號映射成複數幅角。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for phasor definition, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Phasors map approximately sinusoidal signals to complex amplitude. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: State RMS or peak convention. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「相量定義」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping phasor definition verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「相量定義」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for phasor definition; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 相量把近似正弦訊號映射成複數幅角。
knowledge.textEn: Phasors map approximately sinusoidal signals to complex amplitude.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: State RMS or peak convention. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設頻率 60 Hz，時間偏差 Δt=1 μs，純相位誤差 Δθ=2πfΔt=0.000377 rad≈0.0216°。小角度且幅值無誤差時 TVE≈0.0377%；這不含感測器或動態誤差。
knowledge.textEn: At 60 Hz and Δt=1 μs, phase error Δθ=2πfΔt=0.000377 rad≈0.0216°. With no amplitude error and small angle, TVE≈0.0377%; sensor and dynamic errors are excluded.

quiz.question: 審查「相量定義」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for phasor definition?
options: 相量把近似正弦訊號映射成複數幅角。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「相量定義」的驗證。
只調整「相量定義」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Phasors map approximately sinusoidal signals to complex amplitude.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping phasor definition verification.
Tuning the displayed phasor definition result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 相量把近似正弦訊號映射成複數幅角。 寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。
quiz.explanationEn: Phasors map approximately sinusoidal signals to complex amplitude. State RMS or peak convention.

steps.title: 相量定義：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「相量定義」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for phasor definition.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。 比較差異是否符合「相量把近似正弦訊號映射成複數幅角。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. State RMS or peak convention. Compare the result against: Phasors map approximately sinusoidal signals to complex amplitude. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 寫明 RMS 或峰值慣例。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「相量定義」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping phasor definition verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「相量定義」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for phasor definition; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
